integrity: All 20,349 five-subsets are checked by a self-contained standard-library exact determinant program; mathematical proof uses classical complete 27-line theorem and Picard descent.
scientific_limitations: Only the displayed binary cubic; no classification of other arithmetic twists or base fields. Potential unindexed equivalent numerical tables remain an originality risk.
title: Twenty-one effective rays and fifty-one nef rays on the binary symplectic cubic
